Vegan lentil curry for busy weeknights
I make this lentil curry almost every week because it takes only thirty minutes and uses ingredients I always keep in the pantry. Red lentils break down into a creamy sauce with coconut milk, ginger and garlic, and I toss in a handful of spinach at the end. I serve it with basmati rice and a squeeze of lime. My friends always ask for the recipe after trying it, and it freezes well for meal prep.

fixtures.text:
Ten days in Japan on a tight budget
We spent ten days traveling from Tokyo to Kyoto using only local trains and hostel dorms. Tokyo was overwhelming at first, but the metro map becomes easy after two days. In Kyoto we rented bicycles and rode along the river past the bamboo groves before the crowds arrived. Food was cheaper than expected, convenience store lunches rarely cost more than five dollars. The only expensive part was the bullet train between cities, so book the regional pass instead.

fixtures.text:
Best steakhouse downtown a full review
We visited the new steakhouse on Saturday and ordered the dry aged ribeye for two. The meat was cooked perfectly medium rare with a charcoal crust and a side of roasted potatoes. Service was slow at first but improved once the restaurant filled up. The wine list is decent for the price and the dessert menu includes a surprisingly good chocolate tart. Reservations are recommended on weekends because the place was fully booked by seven in the evening.
